text: A force-push to agent_workspace clears all aee-artifact registrations — after a force-push all four required artifacts (Component Index, Security Chains, Extract Log, Security Log) will be missing and verifier must [PASS] until upstream agents re-register them.

When a file document's overview paragraph makes factual claims without inline (file:Lstart-Lend) citations but the Defined Symbols table provides full line references, this is a warning-severity missing-citation issue (not an error) — the document passes the quality bar since all data is cited in the table.

aee-inventory table rows in file documents may contain escaped pipes (\|) in return-type signatures — always replace \| before splitting table columns by |, otherwise column indices shift and produce false wrong-citation or missing-symbol verdicts.
